name: back
description: Page back: a chevron and the name of the page it returns to, in printed caps. Pushed pages only; never on a destination.

label.description: The page it returns to ("You", "Today"), final copy.

href.description: Where it goes. In the product it is history back to that page.

states.hover: yes: the text and chevron turn --block
states.disabled: n/a: a pushed page always has somewhere to go back to

assets.file: inline SVG chevron (24x24 viewBox, stroke currentColor)

a11y.labels: the visible label names it; the chevron is aria-hidden

responsive.700: on its own full-width line in the masthead (revision 21, legacy placement)
responsive.1200: in the title block, start-aligned with --s6 below (legacy context .title)

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css B3 (.back) and its masthead and title-block contexts.
